comment: [R87, docs/PUBLIC-IMAGES-2026-10-16.md] The overlay the kernel applies on top of the tier manifest when the image's build-time profile is public (/etc/kairos/profile = public, written by scripts/public-image-prep.sh; KAIROS_PROFILE overrides). The owner's private images have no profile file and never read this file. Muse (the tier's `image`) has no redistribution grant outside civitai and civitai serves it only to a logged-in account (LICENCES-PUBLIC §3): a public image never carries it. Until the user adds it with their OWN civitai API key, `image` and `image_safe` are the tier's `image_classic` files (Z-Image-Turbo, Apache-2.0, anonymous Hugging Face URLs) with Muse's prompt-rule families; once Muse is installed the tier's own `image` / `image_safe` sections apply unchanged, as on the owner's images. `essentials` = the baked files a public image may leave out (the minimal image): they download at first boot (aria2c, resumable, sha256-checked).

image_default.comment: [R87] the public default while Muse is not installed: the tier's `image_classic` files and tuned arguments (Z-Image-Turbo — 26.6 s per 1024² picture on the RTX 4070, docs/INTEGRATION-2026-09-28.md) with the default's prompt rules (krea-neutral: people as requested, every person an adult 25+ whenever nudity or sex is involved; krea-18plus on an explicit adult request). `classic` stays the same model without prompt expansion.

image_safe.comment: [R87] the public SFW path while Muse is not installed: the default's files through the SFW expander (Krea's rule 8, 'assume clothing covers…'), as `image_safe` is Muse + that expander on the owner's images.

vision_encoder.comment: [R87] the vision add-on's weights as their own entry: the tier's `image.text_encoder` (Muse's text encoder — Q4_K_M on the 8 GB tier, Q8_0 above), copied here because in the public profile `image` may be Z-Image, whose text encoder is a text-only Qwen3-4B; `vision` points here.
